## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle commentary on the *[Śrīmālā-siṃha-nāda-sūtra](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0045)* is by [慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0) *Jìngyǐng Huìyuǎn* (the Suí *Dìlùn*-school master, 523–592, distinct from the much earlier Lúshān Huìyuǎn of 334–416). The work belongs to Huìyuǎn's vast commentarial corpus on the major Mahāyāna scriptures and represents the canonical Suí-period reading of the *Śrīmālā*.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (580 – 592) reflects [慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0) *Jìngyǐng Huìyuǎn*'s mature scholarly period. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X351).
